items.topic: Proximal tibial physeal fracture: reduction, stability, and indications for fixation
items.destination_intent: Peds OITE — 2026; https://www.notion.so/3b4097df81158193b5e5f12fb4d5222a; reconcile upon a durable logging request
items.teaching_point_placement: Beside radiographic recognition and the closed reduction/casting versus fixation discriminator
items.caption_intent: Exact uploaded 2025 OITE screenshot, encounter 2026-11-04: 10-year-old after knee trauma. The bank identifies a displaced proximal tibial Salter-Harris I injury. Supplied radiographs retained without inferring additional fine details from the small panels. Bank discussion supports closed reduction and casting if stable, fixation for instability, and open reduction for irreducibility.
